# Native Waters

> Sourced reference for the native freshwater fishes of five Indian river systems (Ganga, Brahmaputra, Cauvery, Krishna, Godavari), with an illustrative underwater experience.

Native Waters is a sourced reference for native freshwater fishes of five Indian river systems, paired with an illustrative underwater experience. All data is derived from cited publications; see the citations on each page.

## Citation policy
Data is derived from cited publications; each page lists its sources. Species names follow the cited sources, and basin-native status is only claimed where the cited evidence supports it.

## Conservation data
IUCN Red List categories, assessment dates, maximum recorded length, environment and distribution come from FishBase species summaries (IUCN Red List version 2025-2). Six of the thirteen recorded species are listed as threatened. Not Evaluated means unassessed, not safe.
